summary.text: Greg Burtt is a Republican state representative from the Caledonia-Washington District who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Greg Burtt was born in Cabot, Vermont, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Vermont.
Burtt's career experience includes working as an orchard owner.
